summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 251,525 Class I shares for $2,286,359, priced based on July 31, 2026 NAV plus sales load, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The filing also discloses a declared monthly distribution of $0.070100 per share across classes and provides status of its continuous public offering. This is a routine periodic disclosure of securities sales and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or activist activity is present. What to watch: none; the filing is administrative in nature.
